item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 07/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coastal areas of Guangdong today and tomorrow, and a broad trough of low pressure will also bring showers to the region and the northern part of the South China Sea. An anticyclone aloft is expected to affect Guangdong on Friday, the weather will improve over the region. With the anticyclone aloft weakening, there will be sunny intervals and a few showers on the Mid-Autumn Festival and the day after over the coast of Guangdong. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific will move across the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days.
